name: EXP 020 amendment 05. It is not a runner amendment of runner/PROTOCOL-S2.md, whose own amendments 01 to 04 are a different list; each is named in full below.
title: S2's run record: the pause, all 13 discards and the report's hashes
why: S2 is complete, and its report was computed under the published rules. How it got there is written only in the private run log: a pause of 13 days and 6 hours, a stack-stop incident, four more discarded cells than amendment 01 lists, and the report's own refusal of two cells. A reader of the verdict needs that record and the hashes of what the report read, so this amendment states them. It records facts and changes no rule.
timing: The report was computed once all 60 counted cells existed, on 2026-11-08, after amendment 04 was merged (odin-rnd #147, 2026-10-28), as amendment 04 requires. The runner owner drafted this record at private commit 9d24bd858d040ebc7c8e8e3a1a3422d3a7519e52 on 2026-11-08 at 15:02Z. It is published after the report was computed, because it records how the run went; it does not change how the report decides.

changes.what: The pause of 13 days and 6 hours
changes.rule: The last counted cell before the pause ended on 2026-10-25 at 19:58:54, and discards were applied at 21:33:41, with 39 counted cells kept. The plan was then held by the shared pause flag. Its 5 holders had all died, and the flag was stale from 2026-10-27 11:43. The flag was removed on 2026-11-08 at 01:54:03 and the plan resumed at 01:55:00. No counted cell ran between 2026-10-25 19:58:54 and 2026-11-08 01:55:00, 13 days, 5 hours and 56 minutes. The second pass re-measured exactly the missing cells, and the plan completed on 2026-11-08 at 09:22:22 with 60 of 60 counted cells.
changes.sameHost: The runner owner reports the same host and the same Docker data disk as the kept cells. One pg_test_fsync run on 2026-11-08 shows fdatasync at 568.9 ops/s and open_datasync at 565.3 ops/s (one 8 kB write); the runner owner's 10-25 figures were 539 and 560. Only the 11-08 probe is a committed file.

changes.what: The stack-stop incident, with no discard
changes.rule: On 2026-11-08 at 01:59:30, a wrong process check in a helper script that runs after the plan stopped the database stack in the middle of a cell. That cell and the 21 after it each failed in 0 to 1 s ('client not running') and wrote no file. No counted cell was affected. The script was fixed and the plan restarted at 02:02:10.

changes.class: run record: the disturbance rule of amendment 01, applied
changes.rule: A counted cell that ran while other heavy work ran on the same host is discarded and re-run; nothing is pooled. Amendment 01 lists the first nine. This lists all 13.

changes.disclosed: The last two were refused by the report, not flagged in the disturbance log: the log names 11 discards, the discarded/ directory holds 13 files. The two are explained only in the run log, and the runner owner's drafter caught the gap. Times are the host's local time, CET (UTC+01:00).

changes.what: The disturbance-window refusal rule, as it ran (amendment 04 item 8)
changes.rule: disturbance-windows.json transcribes every row of the private disturbance log at private commit 576463d31edb53082c26764ad75ea788e91a86aa (sha256 e3bad331f58b12292a0c163c0e051f553a741d5e54fcc01f06de99b3ec4172ea) as 14 windows, 9 heavy and 5 light, at UTC+01:00, with inclusive bounds. The report writes nothing while any counted cell's run, from its t0 to its last event, overlaps a heavy window or cannot be placed in time. It lists by name the counted cells that overlap a light window. In the final report no counted cell overlaps a heavy window, and three overlap a light one: mongo-x1-rep2-seed2 (window 7), outbox-x10-rep3-seed1 (window 3) and pgoutput-x10-rep4-seed1 (window 3). All 60 run intervals came from the cells' own t0, none from the run log.
changes.judgement: Calling the light rows (single-core unit tests, no browser, no database) not heavy is a judgement. It is recorded so a reader can disagree.

REPORT.json and REPORT.md are the report's outputs. RESULT.json is a later copy of REPORT.json's verdicts for the lab's fit map, added at 94125bedcf6ce50f24fa1c56a1869b2d128bccf4; it is not something the report read. changes.what: The verdict, as the report states it
changes.class: run record: the report's verdict, quoted, not recomputed here
changes.rule: S2 is postgres-fits at 1x and at 10x, with pgoutput chosen as the PostgreSQL variant at both scales. At 1x PostgreSQL's lag p95 is at least 20 % lower in 5 of 5 seed-1 pairs, at 10x in 4 of 5, and at both scales the seed-2 reproduction agrees (median paired difference, MongoDB minus PostgreSQL, +4.8 ms and +8.4 ms). Every one of the 60 counted cells passed the gate, 0 lost and 0 duplicated. Secondary, never deciding: against the zero-component outbox variant alone, MongoDB fits at both scales (5 of 5 pairs, reproduced: -43.6 ms and -40.0 ms). The components count that decides is 4 / 5 / 0 (MongoDB / pgoutput / outbox); latency decided, so it was not reached. S1, S3 and S4 have not been run.
changes.source: REPORT.json: verdicts.x1, verdicts.x10; scales.<x1|x10>.primary.wins and primary.repro.median_paired_diff_ms; scales.<x1|x10>.secondary.2_selection.chosen; scales.<x1|x10>.secondary.3_single_variant.outbox.

sources.what: The runner owner's draft of this record, with the S2 result page

verifiedHere: The publisher fetched the ten listed files in change 5 from the private repository at commit 9d24bd85 and recomputed each sha256: all ten match. The 60 cell hashes are copied from REPORT.json; the publisher did not fetch the cell files. The publisher read change 6's numbers from REPORT.json (verdicts, the chosen variant, the wins, the reproduction medians, the outbox-alone line, 60 cell hashes, 14 / 9 / 5 windows with no heavy overlap and the three light overlaps) and the 13 file names in discarded/: all match this record. The publisher did not rerun the report.
limits: The report, its inputs and the 60 cell files are in a private repository and are cited here by commit and sha256, not published. A reader can check a hash but cannot open the files, so the verdict in change 6 is the report's, quoted, not something this repository lets a reader recompute.
The pause, the incident and the discard times are the runner owner's account and the private run log's; they are not independently verifiable from this repository.

That the 11-08 cells ran on the same host and disk as the 10-25 cells is the runner owner's statement. The 10-25 fsync figures are the runner owner's numbers; only the 11-08 probe is a committed file.
Two discards were refused by the report's overlap check and are missing from the disturbance log; they are explained only in the run log.
Three counted cells are kept under a light overlap; calling those windows light is a judgement.

The variant is chosen on seed 1 and compared on the same seed-1 data, which leans slightly toward PostgreSQL (amendments 02 and 03, and both advocates' reviews). Seed 2's lag values are out of sample; its gate outcomes are not.
One machine and one OS stack. The pre-registered second-OS replication has not been run.
unchanged: No rule changes. The pre-registration and amendments 01 to 04 stand and stay byte-identical: one PostgreSQL variant per scale, chosen once on seed 1; the 20 % margin, the 4-of-5 wins and the reproduction rule; the components count 4 / 5 / 0 with the literal counts beside it; the disturbance refusal of amendment 04 item 8. S1, S3 and S4 are not affected.
notBefore: Effective when merged to main of odin-labs-ai/odin-rnd. It records a computed report and holds nothing back.
